A pozíció egyik legfontosabb feladata egy új, zöldmezős beruházás keretében megvalósuló épület és szerverterem kivitelezésének műszaki koordinációja lesz. A projekt várhatóan körülbelül két évig tart, és a teljes kivitelezési folyamat során számítunk az új kolléga szakmai jelenlétére.

Mivel foglalkozol majd?

  • új és meglévő telephelyek bővítési és kivitelezési munkáinak helyszíni koordinációjával;
  • műszaki tervek átnézésével, kivitelezési problémák felismerésével és egyeztetésével;
  • kivitelezők, alvállalkozók és beszállítók munkájának koordinálásával és műszaki ellenőrzésével;
  • műszaki bejárásokon és kooperációkon való részvétellel;
  • ajánlatkérések, pótmunkák és műszaki változtatások szakmai támogatásával;
  • hatósági és használatbavételi folyamatok követésével;
  • a meglévő telephelyek infrastruktúrájának és karbantartási feladatainak támogatásával;
  • szolgáltatókkal, hatóságokkal és belső szakmai területekkel való kapcsolattartással.

A projekt során fontos, hogy értsd a tervrajzokat, átlásd a kivitelezési folyamatot, és szakmailag megfelelő partner legyél a kivitelezők számára. Nem pusztán adminisztratív projektkoordinátort keresünk: olyan kollégára van szükség, aki a helyszínen is felismeri a problémákat, tud kérdezni, egyeztetni és szükség esetén szakmai álláspontot képviselni.

Munkavégzés

A munkavégzés alapvetően Szigetszentmiklóson történik, az új telephely építése alatt pedig rendszeres helyszíni jelenlétre lesz szükség Veszprém megyében is. Jelenlegi várakozás szerint ez a projekt intenzívebb szakaszaiban akár heti 2–3 napot is jelenthet. Üzleti célú vidéki utazáshoz céges pool autó áll rendelkezésre.



Requirements

Téged keresünk, ha

  • építészmérnöki, építőmérnöki vagy más releváns felsőfokú műszaki végzettséged van;
  • legalább 2 év tapasztalatot szereztél építési/kivitelezési projekt szervezésében vagy levezetésében;
  • rendelkezel projektmenedzsment tapasztalattal;
  • magabiztosan olvasol műszaki terveket;
  • van tapasztalatod MS Office, MS Project és AutoCAD használatában;
  • rendelkezel használható, legalább középfokú angol nyelvtudással;
  • önállóan, precízen és megoldásorientáltan dolgozol;
  • jól kezeled a helyszíni kivitelezésből adódó változásokat és problémákat;
  • rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal.

Előnyt jelent

Felelős műszaki vezetői vagy műszaki ellenőri jogosultság építészeti szakágban, építésvezetői tapasztalat, illetve gépészeti és villamos szakágak ismerete. Ezek azonban kiegészítő előnyt jelentenek — a pozíció elsődleges fókusza az építészeti/kivitelezési terület.




Benefits

Amit kínálunk

  • stabil, hosszú távú szakmai környezet;
  • önálló, felelősségteljes szerep egy jelentős új beruházásban;
  • alapbér mellett teljesítményhez és vállalati eredményhez kapcsolódó bónusz;
  • cafeteria;
  • munkába járási költségtérítés;
  • nyugdíjpénztári támogatás;
  • modern munkakörnyezet és szakmai fejlődési lehetőség.

Ha van valódi építési/kivitelezési projekt tapasztalatod, és szívesen lennél egy új telephely megvalósításának aktív műszaki szereplője, várjuk jelentkezésedet.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager (R14286)
description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

The Staff Technical Program Manager exists to drive complex technical programs that help the Engineering Ecosystem Org deliver member value with high speed and high quality. In year one, success means establishing clear program plans and roadmaps, improving information flow through thoughtful automation, and delivering high-impact initiatives in close partnership with engineering and cross-functional teams.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You'll drive continuous improvement in program management processes and practices, fostering innovation, operational excellence, and predictable execution.
  • You'll lead and manage multiple complex technical programs from inception through delivery, ensuring clear scope, milestones, dependencies, and outcomes.
  • You'll partner with engineering, product management, marketing, legal, compliance, security, risk, and operations to define program goals, deliverables, and execution plans.
  • You'll develop detailed program plans, schedules, and roadmaps that align technical work with business objectives and priorities.
  • You'll own and improve information-flow pipelines that reduce friction, surface the right level of detail to stakeholders, and reduce manual toil through automation.
  • You'll identify and mitigate program risks and dependencies, driving timely resolution of issues and roadblocks.
  • You'll communicate program status, progress, decisions, and challenges to stakeholders at all levels through clear, concise updates and reporting
  • You'll build strong relationships across teams and mentor junior program managers by sharing knowledge, tools, and effective program-management practices.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You're a strategic, hands-on program leader who can turn complex technical work into clear plans, decisions, and outcomes. You bring structure to ambiguity, build trust across functions, and keep teams aligned through execution.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

  • You'll have 8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a focus on large-scale, complex programs.
  • You've demonstrated a strong track record of delivering technical programs on time and within budget.
  • You bring a strong technical background and deep understanding of software development processes and methodologies.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Agile and/or Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience or knowledge in financial services.
  • You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting other program managers and leading cross-functional initiatives.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

US Benefits:

401(k) Company Match;

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance;

Life & Disability Insurance;

Flexible PTO.

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-RR1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: .

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern | Summer 2027
description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

DLR Group’s Orlando studio has an opening for a Mechanical Engineering Summer Intern.

We have multiple positions and locations available; please refer to all openings posted and apply to the locations that are most suitable for your living situation during the course of your internship. This is not a remote position.

About EPX at DLR Group

As an intern at DLR Group, you’ll be part of our Emerging Professional Experience (EPX) Program, designed to give you a meaningful introduction to life within an integrated design firm and a strong foundation for your career in the AEC industry.

Each person at DLR Group has a design voice, and EPX gives you opportunities to develop and share yours. Through hands-on project work, mentorship, and learning experiences, you’ll gain exposure to the people, disciplines, and ideas that shape the built environment. You may participate in design discussions, project meetings, site visits, business development efforts, office activities, and other experiences that broaden your understanding of the design profession.

The program combines three core components: mentorship, project work, and weekly learning sessions. Topics may include design culture, sustainability, design technology, communication, marketing and business development, project and resource management, research, equity, career development, and more. Along the way, you’ll hear from leaders and integrated designers across DLR Group and build connections with fellow emerging professionals.

Position Summary

As a Mechanical Engineering Intern at DLR Group, you will be an important part of our integrated design team, contributing to the design of mechanical systems for buildings of various types, sizes, and complexities. Working alongside mechanical engineers and professionals across architecture, engineering, interiors, and other disciplines, you will gain hands-on experience with the design process from early concepts and system development through documentation and construction administration.

Our Summer Internship Program is a paid, full-time opportunity running May 18 through August 6, 2027, and interns are expected to participate for the duration of the program. This is an opportunity to apply what you’ve learned in the classroom, build your technical and professional skills, and contribute your perspective to design solutions that support our brand promise of Elevating the Human Experience through design.

What you will do

  • Work with a licensed engineer designing mechanical systems for new construction and/or building renovation projects
  • Attend design team meetings with a mechanical engineer and observe the coordination that occurs among the team members of a multi-disciplinary design team
  • Assist a mechanical engineer with the design and development of construction documents primarily using Revit
  • Visit an active construction site (contingent on the status of local construction projects)
  • Develop HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection designs from concept through completion

Required Qualifications:

  • Completed at least one year at an ABET-accredited Mechanical Engineering or Architectural Engineering program
  • Experience or interest in BIM (e.g. Autodesk Revit MEP) workflow

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam
  • Interest in architectural building design
  • A third-year student in an accredited engineering program

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

#LI-

DLR Group is an integrated design firm delivering architecture, engineering, interiors, planning, and building optimization for new builds, renovations, and adaptive reuse projects.

We are 100% employee-owned: every employee is literally invested in our clients’ success. At the core of our firm are interdisciplinary teams engaged in every step of project lifecycles. Our teams champion true collaboration, open information sharing, shared risk and reward, value-based decision making, and proficient use of technology to deliver exceptional design. We are pursuing the goals of the 2030 Challenge, the ME2040, and the SE2050, and are an initial signatory of the China Accord and the AIA 2030 Commitment.

Through our values – commitment, creativity, environmental stewardship, fun, integrity, ownership, sharing, teamwork – we elevate the human experience through design, together.

DLR Group follows a four-day in-office work model, with employees having the flexibility to work somewhere other than the office on Fridays.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/M/F/Veteran/Disabled employer.

title: Process Operator III
description:
Buckeye is the premier infrastructure and logistics provider for the world’s energy needs, both today and tomorrow. Since 1886, we have successfully navigated transitions in the way energy has been distributed to continually meet the needs of an evolving market and industry environment. Our people are a critical element to the success and longevity of our operational history and our future as we seek to thrive through the energy transition.

We own and operate a diversified global network of integrated assets providing midstream logistic solutions, primarily consisting of the transportation, storage, processing, and marketing of liquid petroleum products. We are committed to safely and responsibly providing world-class service to meet the continually evolving energy needs of our customers and the communities we serve. As part of this commitment to our customers, we are continually diversifying our platform and service offerings to enable less carbon intensive energy solutions and undertaking decarbonization efforts on our operations.

Buckeye Partners is currently seeking a Process Operator III with experience in refinery, terminal or pipeline operations to join our team!

Role Summary:

The Process Operator role is responsible for safe, compliant, reliable production all refining operations and utilities operations according to Shift Supervisor instructions and standard operating procedures and guidelines.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities include:

  • Operations. Ensure plant is operating safely; within environmental limits and reliably and efficiently. This role serves as the key player for multiple operational areas including terminals, tank farm, pressurized and refrigerated LPG storage, Refinery Operations. Experience running a Console Desk for both OSBL and LPG areas which would include control variables such as temperature, pressure, level and flow rates. Operate fired heaters, compressors, exchangers, stabilizers, strippers, towers, boilers, etc.

  • Daily Job Duties. Patrol units to ensure safety. Report malfunctioning equipment. Regulate pumps and compressors. Take product samples. Aligning product receipt and deliveries, sampling products, conducting and overseeing routine inspections for compliance with company, industry and government standards, monitoring the pressurized storage process by ensuring continuous flow into the refrigerated tanks and assisting other operators when circumstances require it during upsets, preparation of equipment for maintenance, etc.

  • Safety and Compliance. Executing operations safely on all facilities while maintaining safety, reliability, profitability and product quality, serving as the key player in obtaining a Zero injury safety initiative and Safe and reliable Process Unit Operations and effectively implementing the safety program and the use of all related tools. Responsible to identify hazards and mitigate risks to as low as reasonably practical LARP. Establish safe work conditions for all work executed inside the facility, including open flame hot work, confined space entry and all hazardous work permits.

  • Emergency Response. Participating on Emergency Response Team to act promptly in case of emergencies, including incipient stage fires, vapor cloud release, donning SCBA for response to potential exposures. Participating in safety meetings and periodic emergency response drills and discussions; and reviewing Operating procedures, including Critical Task and Special procedures and Emergency Planning and Preparedness.

  • Reliability. Ensuring Equipment Reliability Operating envelopes are closely followed during and that requires data is recorded and reviewed, preparing Work Orders including those for Emergency work, reporting and helping analyze equipment failures with Maintenance Technicians and provides information necessary to conduct root cause analysis and preparing and following up on Operating Envelope deviations.

  • Personnel and training. Attending mandatory trainings and Firefighting training and assisting and mentoring teammates as needed.

  • Internal Control. Ensuring that all control requirements (API/local regulations, DOT) are applied consistently.

  • And other duties as assigned.

Position Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent

  • 5+ years of experience in terminal or refinery operations is a preferred

Certificates & Licenses:

  • Eligibility for TWIC card as dictated by facility and governmental regulations

Other Skills, Attributes and Abilities:

  • Strong leadership skills.

  • Safety oriented

  • Good communication skills.

  • Creative and analytical problem solving.

  • Strong initiative and dependability

  • Ability to work 12 hours shifts

Essential Functions:

  • This position requires the ability to safely and successfully perform essential job functions consistent with ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards, including meeting qualitative and or/quantitative productivity standards.

  • This role requires the ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards.

  • This position requires compliance with all personnel policies.

Physical & Safety Requirements:

  • The employee may be exposed to a hazardous working environment at field locations and must be able to enter and climb above-grade storage tanks.

  • Ability to climb ladders (approx. 50 feet) and work comfortably and safely at heights for extended periods of time.

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work outdoors for extended periods of time during all weather conditions.

About You:

To be successful in the Buckeye culture, our employees must possess a demonstrated commitment to environmental responsibility and regulatory compliance. Excellent communication, both written and verbal, as well as strong organizational skills are paramount. You must work independently and be able to exercise tact, discretion, and professionalism when dealing with internal and external customers, and when handling sensitive and confidential information.

Buckeye wants to create and reward an organizational focus that stimulates the creative and entrepreneurial actions of its employees that result in innovative ways of reducing costs, generating revenues, improving productivity, or improving processes.

People First Culture:

From managing over 5,000 miles of pipeline to commercializing clean energy projects, our people collaborate to provide world-class service and meet the changing energy needs of our customers. Our employee-first culture means that we invest in our employees and equip them to be fully contributing members of high performing teams. We are focused on collaboration, inclusion, empowerment, accountability, and professional development. We want the best in you to bring out the best in us.

Join us as we work together to build a business that is responsive to the needs of the future while continuing to serve the energy needs of communities today.

title: Meat Special Processor
description:
Job Summary:

Responsible for the grinding and chopping of boneless beef, batching and preparing hamburger for grinding, pulling beef trim, boneless beef, bull and cow meat from combo into Vmags, pushing, lifting, and sorting.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Responsible for adding CO2 ice pellets as needed to ensure meat doesn’t rise above safety regulations.
  • Responsible for documenting audio and visual on chop log sheet after each VMag.
  • When the product is finished being chopped, must feed to the auger that feeds to the Kpak.
  • Samples product after each completed batch through FOSS machine to determine if the fat content is at labeling.
  • Removes excess grind from chopping bowl and notifies sanitation.
  • Lock-out-tag out machine to remove the majority of the grind from the auger.
  • Responsible for using the chopper machine.
  • Opens the top of Vmags holding them into place.
  • Logs the combo information into combo log sheet.
  • Remove any plastic from the combo and places combo into combo dumper ensuring that clamps are locked into place to secure load.
  • Use of rack to distribute the grind evenly between the Vmags.
  • Takes completed Vmags to scale to be weighed.
  • Covers completed product with plastic.
  • Must maintain communication with Lead for daily product that is being produced.
  • Ensures that correct film is applied for product.
  • Ensures that each chub is correctly labeled.
  • Places Vmags onto dumper.
  • Responsible for breaking down the Kpak pipes, hose, and wire.
  • Responsible for sanitation of the Kpak and installing plates after sanitation.
  • Ensure label spacing, quantities of special orders and units needed are correct on label machines.
  • Responsible for threading and inspecting labels.
  • Sets the control panel for the weight on the de-nester.
  • Sets the portion for the #1 or #3 product.
  • Responsible for setting de-nester speed and term bar on conveyor depending on product and tray size.
  • Notify Lead when issues arise.
  • Responsible for sanitation of work areas.
  • Assures compliance with all company safety rules.
  • Follow and monitor proper safety equipment usage and safety practices.
  • Follow established programs, policies, and practices to produce safe quality foods that meet regulatory and company requirements.
  • Support the development, implementation, maintenance, and ongoing improvement of the SQF System.
  • Accountable to Denver Processing Food Safety and Quality Principles.
  • In case of an absence another employee with the same qualifications and training will replace that individual.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma
  • Ability to speak, read, and write English Language
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Significant experience in production process
  • Must attend work consistently
  • Forklift Certification
  • Knowledge of knife sharpening procedures.
  • Considerable knowledge of production processes and work requirements
  • Good attention to detail
  • Strong communication skills
  • Display strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Adaptable and dependable with ability to follow direction and work in cooperation with others

Physical Requirements:

  • Standing, walking, bending, lifting, stooping, crouching, kneeling intermittently.
  • Ability to lift up to 50lbs.

Reasonable Accommodations Statement

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Note:

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. An employee may perform other related duties to meet the ongoing needs of the organization; these duties are considered marginal.

EOE, including disability/vets

The applicant who fills this position will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits:

  • Local 7 UFCW Membership
  • Union Vision, Medical, and Dental coverage after 1 year;
  • Paid sick leave
  • Paid vacation after 1 year
  • Pay rate (Step 1 $22.25, Step 2 $23.35, Thereafter $30.17)

title: Enterprise IT Intern, Summer 2027 (Hybrid)
description:
Who We Are

MEMX is a technology-driven exchange operator founded by members to benefit all investors. We operate MEMX Equities, MEMX Options, and MX2 Options, and provide market technology to clients. Our mission is to create healthy competition and advocate for market structure reform that results in more efficient and sensible trading experiences for all investors.

MEMX is seeking an Enterprise IT Intern to support the technology needs of employees across our U.S. equities and options exchanges. This role offers hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment where you’ll learn how laptops and accounts are set up, how support requests are managed, and how our Enterprise IT team keeps colleagues connected and productive. This internship position will be offered as hybrid with 2 days in-person at our co-working office in Midtown-NYC.

*MEMX has currently approved ONLY the following states for remote work: California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, & Utah.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Work alongside the Enterprise IT team to support employees with everyday technology needs
  • Help set up and maintain laptops, accounts, and applications
  • Assist with support requests and learn how to troubleshoot common technical issues
  • Contribute to IT documentation and projects tailored to your experience and the team’s needs
  • Collaborate with colleagues across MEMX and gain insight into how Enterprise IT supports the broader business

Why MEMX

Pay Rate: $30/hourly for undergraduate students

Equal Opportunity Statement

MEMX is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At MEMX, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving innovation and success. We welcome and celebrate individuals from all backgrounds and perspectives, and we strive to create an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

title: Senior Spacecraft Operations Engineer I
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions

SENIOR SPACECRAFT OPERATIONS ENGINEER I

Based on site at Rocket Lab's headquarters in Long Beach, CA the Senior Spacecraft Operations Engineer I is responsible for ensuring the health, safety, and optimal performance of a growing fleet of satellites while meeting mission objectives and SLAs for both commercial and government customers. This includes supporting diverse missions such as LEO constellations, interplanetary exploration, LEO rendezvous, and SDA-related deployments. Your expertise would be critical during commissioning, orbit raising, routine operations, and potentially re-entry phases, ensuring the health and safety of Rocket Lab’s expanding fleet. The Spacecraft Operations team works closely with related teams, such as spacecraft design, AIT, flight software, propulsion, GNC, flight dynamics and ground software development to help improve both the ground and satellite-based capabilities over time.

The space operations experience at Rocket Lab is unique because you will cover a multitude of roles/positions and responsibilities, with the large majority of the technical products being supplied through the vertical integration/in-house.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Leverage automation as a key enabler to operate spacecraft, focusing on software-driven solutions for efficient and reliable mission execution
  • Design, develop and test ground software for long term space operations: ground scripting for robust and automated ops
  • Design, develop and test flight software sequences and FDIR/telemetry configuration to ensure spacecraft health and fault management through software-driven processes
  • Maintain the continuous integration and testing of our operational code
  • Ensure the on-call or shifts of operations
  • Develop test methods and data analysis
  • Develop interface specifications, CONOPS, and other design documents
  • Run validation against spacecraft simulation tools: flatsat, HITL, etc.
  • Support AIT teams across multiple spacecraft integrated tests (TVAC, propulsion stack, DITL)
  • Perform requirements validation and verification for subsystems and spacecraft missions
  • Generate and maintain requirements for spacecraft Missions including the creation and disposition
  • Provide program and product support to team leads and program managers and be a key technical interface between the Auckland, NZ and Long Beach, USA engineering teams

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A SENIOR SPACECRAFT OPERATIONS ENGINEER II:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)
  • 5+ years of direct experience in any of the following: space mission design, satellite subsystems, ground systems, spacecraft command control or spacecraft operations
  • Understanding of key spacecraft subsystems and their associated components, including attitude determination and control, spacecraft electrical power systems, space-ground communications, on-orbit command and data handling, and thermal control
  • Understanding of the space environment, orbital mechanics, and rigid body dynamics
  • Software development experience (Python/Ruby/C/C++/other high-level languages)
  • Ability to obtain and maintain US Security clearance

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master’s or PhD engineering in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)
  • Prior experience in spacecraft operations
  • Prior experience in satellite system design
  • Prior experience in satellite ground systems
  • Exposure to modern development practices – GIT, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure
  • Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) Testing: Exposure to testing frameworks that simulate software behavior in operational environments

title: Corporate Business Intelligence Intern, Winter 2027
description:
Do you enjoy working with data and building the foundations that turn raw information into meaningful insights?

Are you curious about what happens behind the scenes before data reaches a dashboard, report, or AI application? Coveo is looking for a Business Intelligence Developer intern to join our Business Intelligence team. Your mission? Help extract, transform, and structure data from across Coveo’s systems so it can be reliably used by analysts and teams across the business.

The Business Intelligence team makes trusted data accessible to teams across Coveo, supporting everything from executive reporting to HR, Marketing, Finance, and other business functions. As an intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience with modern data technologies, collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders, and learn how strong data foundations support reporting, analytics, and AI use cases.

Your impact, day to day:

  • Extract raw data from business systems and transform it into structured, reliable datasets for analysts and stakeholders.
  • Contribute to integrating Workday data into Snowflake, helping make it more accessible to teams across Coveo.
  • Build and improve data transformation pipelines using Snowflake and dbt.
  • Structure and model data through multiple stages to prepare it for reporting, analytics, and AI use cases.
  • Collaborate with BI analysts and internal stakeholders to understand their data needs and develop solutions that support them.
  • Share progress, challenges, and ideas with your mentor and team during regular check-ins.

The Essentials:

  • You are currently studying Business, Commerce, Management, Software Engineering, or a related program at the Bachelor’s level or higher in the province of Québec.
  • You are able to work from our office 2 days a week. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility, you can benefit from face-to-face learning from your team on office days while home days allow you to focus and complete complex work.
  • You are legally entitled to work full-time in Canada for the duration of the 15 week internship.

Think you’ve got what it takes? Let’s see!

  • You have completed at least one previous internship and are comfortable jumping into technical projects with growing independence.
  • You have hands-on experience with Snowflake through coursework, a previous internship, or another technical project.
  • You have experience extracting, transforming, and structuring raw data to make it available for downstream analysis.
  • You understand the fundamentals of data modeling and how data moves through different stages before reaching its end users.
  • Experience with dbt (data build tool) is an asset; if it’s new to you, you’re eager to learn it.
  • You are curious about modern data architecture, including semantic layers and how data can be structured to support BI and AI use cases.

Join the Coveolife!

You don’t need to check every single box; passion goes a long way and we appreciate that skills are transferable.

Send us your application, we want to hear from you!

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of, for example, age, gender, disability, gaps in CV, national or ethnic background.

This job description was written by humans, assisted by AI. We may leverage technology in our hiring process to help us see the person behind the resume.

Coveo is committed to providing accessible employment practices. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any point during the recruitment process, please contact HR@Coveo.com to discuss your needs.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Location: Hybrid in Minneapolis and St. Paul, Minnesota preferred. Candidates based elsewhere in the United States will be considered.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, Business Hours

Why RowCal?

RowCal is a fast-growing, innovative HOA and Property Management company, bringing "The Smarter Way to HOA" to thriving communities across the United States. Focused on Our Mission "To empower, enrich and elevate HOA communities and the lives of our employees who serve them", we are committed to doing things better with a can-do attitude and joyful spirit that puts HOA leaders at ease. We'll be a partner who cares, collaborates and creates the best HOA experience for a community.Our core values of trust, innovation, fun, and growth are at the heart of everything we do. Help us transform HOA communities and make "home" extra special for the members we serve. You'll love what you do!

Job Summary

The Senior Salesforce Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable Salesforce solutions that drive business operations and revenue growth across the organization. This role serves as the primary technical expert for Salesforce development, integrations, automation, and application architecture, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives. Working closely with business stakeholders, the Revenue Systems Manager, and Technology leadership, the Senior Salesforce Developer delivers innovative solutions that enhance operational efficiency, improve data accessibility, and support enterprise digital transformation initiatives.

Role and Responsibilities

SALESFORCE DEVELOPMENT & ARCHITECTURE

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, and platform events.
  • Own technical design decisions, including data modeling, automation architecture, performance optimization, scalability, and error handling.
  • Maintain and enhance custom Salesforce applications, custom objects, and platform functionality.
  • Refactor legacy solutions and reduce technical debt while maintaining platform stability.
  • Evaluate and recommend technical approaches that balance functionality, scalability, and maintainability. Systems Integration & Data Management
  • Design, build, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and internal or third-party business systems.
  • Support data synchronization, data governance, and platform interoperability initiatives.
  • Ensure accurate and reliable movement of data between Salesforce, operational systems, and enterprise reporting platforms.
  • Partner with technology teams to support Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and data platform initiatives.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities to proactively identify and resolve integration issues.

PLATFORM SECURITY & GOVERNANCE

  • Implement and maintain security best practices, access controls, field-level security, and sharing models.
  • Ensure development solutions comply with organizational standards and applicable privacy requirements.
  • Support platform governance by reviewing new applications, integrations, and enhancement requests.
  • Maintain technical documentation, standards, and development practices that enable long-term platform sustainability. Release Management & Development Operations
  • Manage the Salesforce development lifecycle, including source control, code reviews, testing, deployment, and release management.
  • Establish and maintain development standards, naming conventions, and coding best practices.
  • Support sandbox strategy, deployment planning, testing coordination, and production releases.
  • Review and validate work performed by external developers and consulting partners.

AUTOMATION & EMERGING TECHNOLOGY

  • Evaluate opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, AI, and Salesforce platform capabilities.
  • Develop proofs of concept and pilot solutions to assess business value before implementation.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, and industry best practices.
  • Recommend new technologies and capabilities that support organizational goals.

ADDITONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in technology planning and prioritization processes.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and ongoing platform optimization efforts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Flow, APIs, and Salesforce platform architecture.
  • Experience designing and supporting platform integrations using REST, SOAP, middleware, or event-driven solutions.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, sharing models, data structures, and governor limits.
  • Experience utilizing source control, sandbox management, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment best practices.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required or strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
  • Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Integration Architect, or Data Architect certifications.
  • Experience with HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, PandaDoc, Mailchimp, Domo, Insycle, or similar integrated platforms.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse architecture, or modern cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with Agentforce, Einstein AI capabilities, or Salesforce automation technologies.
  • Background supporting property management, HOA management, field services, or multi-location operations.
  • Experience with JavaScript, Node.js, or other modern development frameworks

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work at a computer for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to analyze technical issues and review system configurations for prolonged periods.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in written, verbal, and virtual environments.
  • Ability to travel occasionally for meetings, training, and company events as needed.

Pay Range

The estimated starting base pay range for this role is $105,000 - $130,000 per year. This good faith estimate is based upon RowCal's typical starting pay range for this role. Actual pay range depends on many factors including each employee's qualifications and market conditions and is subject to change.

Benefits

In addition to offering our team members competitive pay, we offer an excellent benefits package including 401k matching, paid time off, health insurance, dental insurance and vision insurance for employees and dependents. We also offer disability insurance along with other important benefits to ensure that our workers feel respected and valued. title: IT Support Specialist (Temporary)
description:
IT Support Specialist (Temporary)

Department: Operations
Location: Herndon, VA – Hybrid
Employment Type: Temporary
Reports To: Director, Programs & Compliance / VP Operations

Position Summary

Four Inc. is seeking a hands-on, service-oriented IT Support Specialist to provide day-to-day technology and systems support for our employees and office. This temporary role will serve as an on-site resource for employee technology needs, including preparing laptops for new hire onboarding, coordinating systems access, troubleshooting hardware and office technology, and managing support requests through our outsourced IT provider.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, technically capable, and comfortable troubleshooting issues directly while also knowing when to escalate more complex matters to our external IT partner. This role requires strong attention to detail and a customer-service mindset, particularly when supporting employee onboarding, offboarding, and day-to-day technology needs.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Prepare company laptops for IT provider provisioning
  • Coordinate technology setup for new hires, including laptops, monitors, peripherals, software, system access, and other required equipment.
  • Support employee offboarding by coordinating the removal of systems access and collection, inventory, and preparation of returned equipment.
  • Set up, modify, and deactivate employee access to company systems and applications in accordance with established processes and approvals.
  • Issue, activate, deactivate, and maintain Datawatch building access cards for employees and other authorized users.
  • Provide hands-on Tier 1 technical support to employees experiencing hardware, software, connectivity, or access issues.
  • Troubleshoot laptops, monitors, docking stations, printers, peripherals, and other office technology.
  • Troubleshoot conference room technology, including displays, cameras, microphones, speakers, and video conferencing equipment, and provide support for meetings as needed.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison with the company’s outsourced IT provider.
  • Submit, monitor, update, and follow up on support tickets through the outsourced IT vendor’s ticketing system to ensure issues are addressed promptly and appropriately.
  • Escalate technical issues to the outsourced IT provider when additional expertise or administrative access is required and coordinate through resolution.
  • Maintain accurate records of company IT assets, including laptops, monitors, peripherals, access cards, and other assigned equipment.
  • Track equipment assignments, returns, replacements, and available inventory.
  • Assist with ordering, receiving, organizing, and deploying IT equipment and supplies.
  • Perform routine checks of printers, conference rooms, and other shared office technology to identify and resolve issues proactively.
  • Document common troubleshooting procedures, equipment configurations, and recurring IT processes.
  • Assist with other technology and office systems projects as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in IT support, help desk, desktop support, technical support, or a similar hands-on technology role preferred.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting Windows-based laptops and common business applications.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and common workplace technology.
  • Experience troubleshooting printers, peripherals, audiovisual equipment, and conference room technology.
  • Experience working with an IT help desk or ticketing system.
  • Ability to diagnose basic technical issues independently and determine when escalation is appropriate.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing equipment, user access, and multiple open support requests.
  • Strong customer-service and communication skills with the ability to support employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.
  • Ability to handle confidential information and systems access responsibly.
  • Ability to prioritize competing requests and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Comfortable working independently while coordinating closely with an outsourced IT provider.

Physical and Work Requirements

  • This is a hands-on, hybrid position based in Four Inc.’s Herndon, Virginia office.
  • Ability to move, set up, and connect laptops, monitors, docking stations, printers, and other office technology.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and carry IT equipment weighing up to approximately 30 pounds.
  • Regular movement throughout the office may be required to provide employee and conference room support.

Temporary Assignment

This position is a temporary assignment intended to provide hands-on IT and technology support based on current business needs. The duration and schedule of the assignment will be communicated at the time of hire and may be adjusted based on business requirements.

title: Outpatient Clinician - Per-Diem
description:
Outpatient Clinician Per-Diem

Milford

Salary Range: $35.00 - $45.00/hour.

Wayside is seeking Master's level Clinicians to provide collaborative outpatient clinical services to children, adolescents, and their families. We offer a Fee-for-Service, hybrid position, with flexibility to meet with clients virtually and at our offices in Milford. Some after-school/evening hours are required.

What you will do:

Provide short term and ongoing individual, sibling, and family treatment as clinically indicated and in accordance with program specifications for youth between 2 and 20 years old.
Conduct intakes for new clients, assessing for medical necessity as indicated.
Complete comprehensive clinical assessments, CANS and develop treatment plans according to program specifications.
Provide crisis intervention services with clients as needed.
Collaborate with family, schools, and other providers throughout treatment and make referrals to community supports as needed.
Serve as HUB for services such as therapeutic mentoring when needed.

Competencies/Traits of Our Superstars:

Ability to highlight and validate strengths in young people and their families.
Respectful curiosity to learn from a person’s lived experiences.

Work within a recovery model framework emphasizing the person’s journey not just their diagnosis.

Access to monthly agency- sponsored trainings on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion as well as other clinically relevant topics with associated Continuing Education hours.

title: Security Engineer - Internship
description:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

SeatGeek is looking for a Security Engineering Intern to join our Security team. As an intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience across all aspects of our security program: from application security and threat modeling to detection engineering and incident response. You’ll help protect our users, systems, and data while learning how security operates at scale in a modern, cloud-native environment.

You’ll join a team focused on building proactive, secure-by-default systems through a combination of automation, visibility, and collaboration. Whether you’re assisting in code reviews, building security tools, or supporting incident response efforts, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers and contribute to meaningful projects that strengthen SeatGeek’s overall security posture.

What you'll do

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to provide security guidance on new products and technologies
  • Assist in threat modeling and architecture reviews for upcoming features and products
  • Participate in regular security assessments through basic penetration testing and code reviews of SeatGeek products
  • Learn and promote secure coding practices by working closely with developers
  • Help engineer and enhance security controls to harden our AWS environment and improve visibility
  • Contribute to automation and tooling projects that scale security across the company
  • Support incident response efforts by helping identify vulnerabilities, tune alerts, and enhance detections
  • Participate in Purple team (Red team / Blue team) exercises to understand both offensive and defensive perspectives
  • Share ideas to continuously improve our security programs and shape their future

What you have

  • You’re graduating in spring/summer 2028
  • Proficiency in two or more programming languages (Python, C#, Go) and a solid grasp of coding and code review (yes, there’s a coding interview)
  • Ability to think like an attacker when securing applications, using that mindset to identify potential vulnerabilities and drive meaningful improvements in code security and defensive measures
  • Understanding of secure software development practices, threat modeling, and knowledge of common security vulnerabilities (like OWASP Top Ten)
  • Curiosity and a desire to learn how things work under the hood
  • (Preferred) Contributions to the security community (public research, blogging, presentations, etc.)
  • (Preferred) Experience or strong interest in automating security tasks and scaling security processes through tooling.
  • (Preferred) Familiarity with modern architectures, including microservices, Kubernetes, AWS, and other cloud technologies.
  • (Preferred) Regularly participate in CTF, bug bounty hunting, and hackathons (bonus points if you share your Bugcrowd/HackerOne/HackTheBox profiles)

Our stack

  • Languages: Python, C#, Go,, SQL, and Terraform
  • SCM & CI/CD: GitLab
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation
  • Cloud Platform: AWS
  • Central Logging and Monitoring: Datadog
  • Container Orchestration: Kubernetes
  • Endpoint Detection & Response: CrowdStrike
  • Secrets Management: HashiCorp Vault
  • Dashboarding: Datadog, Hex, and Looker

Internship perks

  • $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
  • Monthly commuter card for transportation
  • Subscription to Headspace
  • Free lunch & snacks is provided every day in the office
  • Weekly planned events like comedy/broadway shows, sports games, museum visits and more
  • Housing stipend

**Please note you are expected to come into the SeatGeek New York City Office at least 3 days a week**

The compensation for this role is $55/hour USD (based on a 40 hour work week).

title: Recordkeeping Operations Associate
description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Recordkeeping Operations Associate at Human Interest, you play a crucial role in advancing our mission to make retirement savings accessible to all working Americans. You support the day-to-day administration of our clients' 401(k) plans, executing and reconciling financially material transactions, including securities trades, corporate actions, distributions, and cash and fund reconciliations, accurately, on time, and in compliance. This role rewards meticulous attention to detail and sound judgment on transactions that carry real financial and participant impact. By owning your assigned work, building deep expertise across several operational functions, surfacing risk early, and documenting your work to a standard that holds up under audit, you directly contribute to keeping retirement plans accurate and trustworthy for businesses across the United States.

About the team

The Recordkeeping Operations team manages the precise and timely execution of complex retirement plan transactions across multiple platforms, maintaining investments and ensuring the absolute accuracy of ledger activity. Daily activity includes executing fiduciary directed fund changes, coordinating the plan asset maintenance resulting from corporate actions, posting transaction activity in the recordkeeping ledger, as well as handling complex cash and fund reconciliations. Team members thrive on continuous improvement and elite execution. As we continue to scale, we focus on maintaining high service standards, optimizing workflows, and strengthening the controls that keep recordkeeping accurate.

What you get to do every day

  • Manage a varied workload across several of the team's recordkeeping functions, such as manual trades and trade funding, corporate actions and the resulting plan asset maintenance, distributions and reversals, source corrections, and NAV monitoring, taking on complex assignments and escalations within those areas.
  • Execute precise review and reconciliation of account data across participant retirement accounts and Human Interest operating, custodial, and suspense accounts, posting corrections that keep the recordkeeping ledger accurate.
  • Autonomously navigate and resolve highly complex, undocumented edge cases and critical escalations, transforming these into clear, actionable Standard Operating Procedure updates.
  • Provide advanced transactional assistance to other Operations teams during high volume periods, product development, or priority business needs.
  • Contribute to and help drive team improvement initiatives.
  • Work cross-functionally to improve processes and contribute to the development of scalable solutions.

What you bring to the role

  • Proven ability to trace complex 401(k) transactions and asset movements through the entire recordkeeping lifecycle to confidently pinpoint and resolve reconciliation or data errors.
  • 2–3 years of experience within 401(k) operations
  • High efficiency output in a fast paced environment, backed by meticulous attention to detail and an uncompromising commitment to quality standards.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, paired with an eager desire to actively participate in a vocal, highly collaborative team culture
  • Excitement to leverage AI and automation tools to optimize repetitive tasks, allowing you to free up bandwidth for complex problem-solving and best-in-class service.
  • Demonstrated success in overcoming complex challenges
  • Proven ability to plan ahead and consistently meet performance goals
  • Strong aptitude for identifying and communicating process improvements
  • Deep understanding of the expected behavior of HI's recordkeeping product
  • Strong demonstration of Human Interest's Operating Principles in daily work
  • Consistent history as a top performer in current HI role

Nice to have

  • Bachelor’s degree OR equivalent experience.
  • ASPPA QKA Certification or equivalent.
  • Power-user status in Microsoft Excel or basic SQL to efficiently trace and reconcile large data set

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $23.61 - $28.00 per hour and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximum in our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)

remote considered, Pacific Time Zone residency required

The People & Places Project and Portfolio Management Office helps turn organizational priorities into coordinated, successful outcomes. The successful candidate will be a pragmatic and influential delivery leader who is comfortable working through ambiguity, builds trust across organizational boundaries, and adapts the level of structure to the needs of each initiative. The successful candidate must reside within the Pacific Time Zone. Preference will be given to candidates located in the Southern California region, however, candidates elsewhere in the Pacific Time Zone may be considered based on experience and overall fit

What We’re Looking For

  • At least six years of progressively responsible project or program management experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead programs and workstreams through influence in a matrixed organization.
  • Strong experience converting ambiguous objectives into clear outcomes, integrated plans, milestones, responsibilities, and decisions.
  • Ability to connect individual initiatives and workstreams to broader strategic objectives and intended business outcomes.

  • Experience managing program risks, dependencies, decisions, scope, schedules, and competing priorities.
  • A practical, adaptable approach that balances delivery discipline with the needs and culture of the business.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with other Program Managers, the Change Manager, functional leaders, sponsors, and the PPMO Director.
  • Experience using modern project, program, and collaboration platforms. The ability to learn and consistently apply the team’s Asana-based portfolio practices is required.

  • Current residency within the Pacific Time Zone.

What Will Help You Stand Out

title: Entry Level Auto Painter/Prepper - Blue Mound, TX
description:
We’re looking for Auto Painters with a minimum of 1 year of professional automotive painting experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As a Painter, you’ll be expected to prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of paint roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see other roles available to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing
  • Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.
  • Mid-Level Painter (min 3 years professional experience): match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths
  • Experienced Painter (min 5 years professional experience): painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Software Engineer AI
description:
Bij Zypp werken we aan de toekomst door state-of-the-art AI-technologieën te ontwikkelen die onze klanten en interne processen vooruithelpen. We zijn een compact, deskundig team met een open cultuur waarin we elkaar stimuleren om het beste uit onszelf te halen. Als jij graag in een omgeving wilt werken waar je technische groei combineert met verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerking, dan past Zypp bij jou.

Jouw rol

Als Software Engineer AI ontwerp en ontwikkel je schaalbare AI-gedreven systemen en applicaties, met een focus op onze eigen Agent platformen en klantgerichte oplossingen. Je vertaalt complexe wensen van klanten naar technische architecturen en concrete AI-toepassingen. Je bent bedreven in het implementeren van LLMs, AI-agents, RAG-technieken, en zorgt dat AI-oplossingen betrouwbaar en beheersbaar in productie draaien. Daarnaast beheers je backend development en infrastructuurkennis, met een voorkeur voor Azure en Supabase. Frontend ervaring is een plus, maar geen vereiste.

Wie we zoeken

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bouwen en schalen van AI-toepassingen die in productie draaien
  • Je kent de werking van LLMs zoals OpenAI en Anthropic en hebt ervaring met AI-agents en tool integraties
  • Je hebt een sterke achtergrond in backend development, bij voorkeur met Python, FastAPI en database design
  • Je bent bekend met API design, software architectuur en onderhoudbare services
  • Je volgt de laatste ontwikkelingen in AI actief en past nieuwe technieken toe
  • Je communiceert helder met technische en niet-technische stakeholders
  • Je hebt een proactieve houding en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het hele ontwikkeltraject
  • Ervaring met cloudplatformen zoals Azure, containerisatie en CI/CD processen is een pré

Wat we bieden

  • Een jong, deskundig team met passie voor innovatie
  • Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Rotterdam, te midden van een bruisende startup community
  • Een omgeving zonder hiërarchie, met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief
  • Direct zichtbare impact doordat je werkt aan oplossingen die klanten echt gebruiken
  • Regelmatige teamactiviteiten en een cultuur van open communicatie en kennisdeling

Over Zypp

Zypp is een innovatief softwarebedrijf dat zich richt op het ontwikkelen van AI-gedreven oplossingen die de manier van werken verbeteren. We geloven in een platte organisatiestructuur met veel vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid voor onze medewerkers. Onze missie is om met vooruitstrevende technologieën bedrijven te helpen hun processen en producten te optimaliseren. We zijn gevestigd in de CIC innovatie hub in Rotterdam, een plek waar veel startups en scale-ups samenkomen om te groeien.

&Work helpt je verder

Zypp werkt samen met &Work. &Work begrijpt dat het belangrijk is om te werken op een plek waar je gewaardeerd wordt, waar je je verder kunt ontwikkelen en waar je de ruimte krijgt om te groeien. title: Community Outreach Specialist
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity!

Common Ground is seeking a Community Outreach Specialist to be a part of the Common Ground Rochester Hills Resiliency Center (RHRC) program.

Current Opening: Full-Time, 40 hours/week

Compensation: $22.00 - $26.00 per hour

About You

The Community Outreach Specialist supports the mission of the Rochester Hills Resiliency Center (RHRC) by fostering strong relationships between the center and the impacted community it serves. The role is responsible for planning, implementing, and evaluating outreach initiatives designed to engage individuals, families, and community organizations in need of support in the aftermath of the mass violence event. Promote awareness of the center’s services through strategic marketing, developing partnerships with stakeholders, and organizing educational events and support activities that enhance resilience and recovery. The Community Outreach Specialist will be responsible for the coordination of the volunteers for the resiliency center.

Day in the Life

  • Develop and implement community outreach strategies to increase visibility and utilization of the center's services
  • Build and maintain partnerships with local organizations, faith-based groups, schools, first responders, healthcare providers, and government agencies
  • Serve as a liaison between the Resiliency Center and the broader community to ensure services are accessible and responsive to local needs
  • Plan, coordinate, and facilitate educational workshops, community advisory strategic planning group, resource fairs, support groups, and other community-centered events
  • Develop outreach materials such as brochures, psychoeducation, newsletters, and social media posts to promote center services and events
  • Manage digital communications and social media presence to increase community awareness and participation
  • Conduct community surveys, focus groups, or informal interviews to gather input and assess local needs
  • Collaborate with the resiliency center team to build and adapt programs based on input received from people served

What you need to apply

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a Human Services or related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience is required
  • Minimum of two (2) years’ experience working in victim services or crisis intervention/mental health services
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record

What Makes Us Different?

  • Non-Profit mission-driven, person-focused environment
  • Trauma Informed Training, including de-escalation and mass violence training
  • Team orientated environment
  • An organizational culture of mental & behavioral health support for all

For your hard work

  • Generous paid time off (for eligible employees)
  • Employer sponsored benefit & wellness plans (including 16% fringe pay, Calm App, etc.)
  • Competitive wages

Common Ground is one of the top-ten crisis intervention organizations in the country. For over 50 years we have been helping people move from crisis to hope. At Common Ground, we help individuals and families who are experiencing crises of any kind, from suicide to substance use, human trafficking, mental illness and more.

Helping people in crisis 24/7 is at the heart of everything we do by offering hope, healing and recovery. Our caring and dedicated team meets people wherever they are – in person, phone call, or virtually. We listen, assist, and advocate for anyone needing emotional support so they do not feel alone.

title: Junior Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Analyst
